texts: When a wraith drains a lantern, the lantern gives weak mist-light.
Whenever a wraith drains a lantern, the lantern shows dim mist-light.
When a lantern attracts a handful of nightmoths, the thread harvest at that lantern falls.

fields.sentence: When a wraith drains a lantern, the lantern gives weak mist-light.
parse: (: whenever_drain_give (Implication (And (Member $w wraith) (Member $dr drain) (Agent $dr $w) (Patient $dr $l) (Member $l lantern)) (And (Member (sk_give $dr) give) (Agent (sk_give $dr) $l) (Theme (sk_give $dr) (sk_light $dr)) (Member (sk_light $dr) mist_light) (Member (sk_light $dr) weak) (During (sk_give $dr) $dr))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Indefinite participants route the bare "when P, Q" to the whenever machinery correctly: plain-variable premises, Skolem-function consequent, During link, (STV 1.0 0.9). mist_light gets its genus and correctly suppresses the noun modifier; the witness for "weak mist-light" is forced because the qualifier needs a bearer.

fields.sentence: Whenever a wraith drains a lantern, the lantern shows dim mist-light.
parse: (: wraith_drain_show_rule (Implication (And (Member $w wraith) (Member $l lantern) (Member $e1 drain) (Agent $e1 $w) (Patient $e1 $l)) (And (Member (sk_show $e1) show) (Agent (sk_show $e1) $l) (Patient (sk_show $e1) (sk_light $e1)) (Member (sk_light $e1) mist_light) (Member (sk_light $e1) dim) (During (sk_show $e1) $e1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: In the consequent the show event's object is given as (Patient (sk_show $e1) (sk_light $e1)), but showing neither creates, destroys, consumes nor physically changes the light, so the yes/no change test (and the unclear-case default) yields Theme.

review.notes: Everything else follows the whenever machinery: plain-variable premises, per-occurrence Skolem event, During link, no tense or QuantifierPhrase; the stative-transitive lantern correctly keeps Agent despite being inanimate, and mist_light gets the head genus only. The descriptive "dim" rightly stays an unfused Member atom on a per-occurrence witness rather than fusing into the kind.

issues.reason: Patient is for an object the action 'creates, destroys, consumes, or physically changes'; what a lantern shows is displayed/perceived and unchanged, and 'when the test is unclear, default to Theme', so (Patient (sk_show $e1) (sk_light $e1)) mis-roles the object.

new_gaps: A bare mass-noun object carrying a descriptive modifier ('dim mist-light'): the bare-kind-filler rule leaves no slot for the modifier, and the instruction set does not name the per-occurrence witness the parse mints for it.
adjudication.defect_summary: Replace (Patient (sk_show $e1) (sk_light $e1)) with (Theme (sk_show $e1) (sk_light $e1)); the rest of the rule stands as is.
adjudication.notes: The whenever form is otherwise compliant: plain-variable premises, per-occurrence Skolems for both the show event and its light, During link, no tense or companion, inanimate transitive subject as Agent, and 'dim' kept as a separate Member atom on the witness.

review.notes: The adjectivally-restricted kind subject correctly forces the distributing-rule route rather than a kind relation, with 'weak' as a premise conjunct and not fused into the compound; 'rarely' sets strength 0.1 with its QuantifierPhrase companion, the bare-kind object filler `nightmoth` is right for a generic clause, and both compound genus atoms are present. Minor: the companion's kind slot names `mist_light` while the rule's actual range is weak mist-light, but `mist_light` does appear in the premise so the companion restates nothing absent from the parse.

fields.sentence: When a lantern attracts a handful of nightmoths, the thread harvest at that lantern falls.
parse: (: when_attract_fall (Implication (And (Member $x attract) (Agent $x $lan) (Member $lan lantern) (Theme $x $m) (GroupOf $m nightmoth) (CardinalityPhrase $m "a handful")) (And (Member (sk_fall $x) fall) (Theme (sk_fall $x) (sk_harvest $lan)) (Member (sk_harvest $lan) thread_harvest) (LocatedIn (sk_harvest $lan) $lan) (During (sk_fall $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Bare 'when P, Q' with indefinite participants correctly routes to the whenever rule (1.0/0.9, no companion); inanimate transitive subject stays Agent, 'a handful' takes CardinalityPhrase on the group, 'falls' is a listed change-of-value verb so the harvest is Theme, 'at that lantern' is inside LocatedIn's containment licence, and 'that lantern' resolves to the premise variable as donkey anaphora. The lantern-keyed Skolem entity (sk_harvest $lan) is the licensed dependent-existential form.
